report_period.name: report_period
report_period.value: ("report"."type" = 'DAILY' AND "report"."report_date" IS NOT NULL AND "report"."week_start" IS NULL AND "report"."week_end" IS NULL AND "report"."week_label" IS NULL) OR ("report"."type" = 'WEEKLY' AND "report"."report_date" IS NULL AND "report"."week_start" IS NOT NULL AND "report"."week_end" IS NOT NULL AND "report"."week_label" IS NOT NULL AND "report"."week_end" = "report"."week_start" + 6 AND "report"."week_label" = "report"."week_start" + 4 AND EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM "report"."week_start") = 1)

report_submission.name: report_submission
report_submission.value: ("report"."status" = 'DRAFT' AND "report"."submitted_at" IS NULL) OR ("report"."status" = 'SUBMITTED' AND "report"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL)

revision_request_review_state.name: revision_request_review_state
revision_request_review_state.value: ("revision_request"."status" = 'PENDING' AND "revision_request"."reviewer_id" IS NULL AND "revision_request"."reviewed_at" IS NULL) OR ("revision_request"."status" IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED') AND "revision_request"."reviewer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "revision_request"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL)
